caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular plaque with a relief scene and an inscription below it, all rendered in grayscale pencil on an off-white sheet of paper. The plaque is bordered by a simple, raised edge and is shown affixed at its four corners, indicated by circular marks resembling mounting holes. In the relief scene occupying the top half of the plaque, there are four human figures, all in profile and facing right. The figures are dressed in clothing with obvious detail, such as hats and tunics, and two of them are holding long, upright objects that appear to be spears or staffs. Below the figures, the lower section of the plaque contains a rectangular area filled with an inscription in uppercase letters. The text is arranged in multiple lines and is stylized with some words emphasized in darker or bolder strokes. The rest of the drawing area is empty, with light discoloration and minor stains present in the background. The entire composition maintains a monochromatic appearance due to the pencil shading and outlines.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
